morgan: Heads-up — we need to schedule the Zenith VPC security handoff with Eng-Infra, Product, and the customer (Zenith). Proposed slots: Tue 2026-03-24 10:00 PT or Wed 2026-03-25 16:00 UTC. Who can make either? I’ll put a calendar invite once we pick a slot.

lee: Tue 10am PT works for me. Prefer earlier in week.

anya: I’m OOO Tue morning, can do Wed 16:00 UTC.

jamie: Wed is better for infra team too. Can we lock Wed if that’s majority?

morgan: Sounds like Wed wins. Tentative: Wed 2026-03-25 16:00 UTC. Agenda + prep checklist below — pls skim and add missing items.

morgan: Agenda (30m):
1) Introductions & scope (5m)
2) Network diagram walkthrough & peering plan (10m)
3) KMS / key access and CMK policy (5m)
4) Firewall rules, bastion + jump host plan (5m)
5) Rollback / cutover plan and post-handoff ownership (5m)

morgan: Preflight checklist (please confirm status):
```
- VPC CIDR finalized: YES
- Customer-provided network diagram: PENDING (zenith to upload)
- KMS CMK policy draft: IN REVIEW (security)
- Service account list + least-privilege IAM: PARTIAL
- Route table / peering approval: PENDING
- Audit logging (CloudTrail / Flow logs): ENABLED
- VPN test/handshake: SCHEDULED
```

devon: I’ll take action on the IAM list, will post the draft by EOD Mon.

lee: Can someone upload the network diagram to the thread? @morgan do we have the customer diagram link?

morgan: Not yet, I asked Zenith this morning and asked them to share in the meeting invite. I’ll ping them again.

securitybot: Reminder: attach the CMK policy to the calendar invite or the meeting will be blocked by compliance.

anya: Also request: can Product (jamie) bring the expected traffic profile? We need sequence length / burst estimates for firewall capacity planning.

jamie: Yup, I’ll add a short traffic estimate doc to the invite — 95th percentile qps + typical burst windows.

morgan: Action items captured: Devon (IAM draft), Jamie (traffic doc), Morgan (ping customer + add CMK policy), Lee (confirm infra attendees). If Wed 16:00 UTC is final, I’ll send invite now and mark items required to review before meeting.

lee: Confirming infra: @sre-oncall and @infra-networking will join.

morgan: Cool. One more thing: if anyone expects to bring screenshots or route table snippets, paste them here beforehand — keeps meeting tight.

anya: Quick Q — will this call include Dedicated capacity config or only VPC/on-prem network?

morgan: Good Q. Primary focus is VPC + KMS + peering. Dedicated sizing touches will be a short FYI from Product, deeper Dedicated config (instance types / GPU sizing) will follow in a separate dedicated follow-up if needed.

ops-bot: calendar invite created by morgan for 2026-03-25 16:00 UTC — guests: jamie, lee, anya, devon, zenith-customer@example.com — link: https://zoom.redwood.com/j/1234567890

morgan: Thanks — please mark the invite as ACCEPTED/DECLINED so I can adjust if we need to pivot. :thumbsup:
